comments.text:
People are complaining about AI entering education. That is good, if it goes beyond YouTube. But, people can make this protest more convincing by saying more than one sentence that only gawks at the situation.  How is any men or women scrolling  here supposed to believe human assistance is better, when these comments are seemingly a reflection of all that it has resulted to: vague notions. And if the general public cannot predict a notable cognitive difference resulting from the hypothetical AI teacher and now, then what makes anyone think the government will?

Please.  Even if you merely write three sentences. Your thinking will feel better after practice. And even if it’s just a digital platform, YouTube is popular. It is  where people, authorities and corporations go to get answers and ideas.  They also get a sense of the digital culture of a population; It’s not just a landfill for phrases that won’t spout any consequences.
